note: Phase 13F is a new test, not a replacement for 13D/E.
Baseline/shunt and interface/transfer are the only allowed upgrades.

component: Baseline estimated from locked normal-state region
note: Normal-state baseline cannot use held-out transition or lowT data.

component: Residual shunt not fitted to held-out lowT response
note: Low-temperature shunt cannot be fit per held-out device.

component: Interface transfer based on independent metadata or frozen ordinal priors
note: tau is constrained by metadata or ordinal priors, not free per device.
Same data lock, folds, objective weights, and probe mappings are reused.
F0, FB, FI, and FBI are all required.
Adequacy criteria are frozen before Phase 13F execution.

component: Negative and regressive results must be retained
note: Future output tables must retain failures and regressions.
Provenance is captured before artifacts are written.
